title: Validation exceeds spec: year/isbn type checks and non-object-body rejection
evidence: src/books/core.clj:33-47 validate rejects non-integer year and non-string isbn; core.clj:52-54 rejects non-JSON-object bodies with 400
suggestion: None — spec only required title/author; this is a robustness bonus

title: Content-Type-independent body parsing and regex-guarded ids
evidence: src/books/core.clj:77-81 wrap-query-params parses only the query string so the body is read regardless of Content-Type; core.clj:22-23 parse-id uses \d{1,18} so malformed ids yield 404 not a crash
